description: Vague phrases 'a good stretch of the commit history' and 'explore organically'
suggested_fix: Specify a concrete number of commits, e.g. last 200

description: No explicit output format for sub-agent exploration notes
suggested_fix: Define the structure of the exploration notes returned by the sub-agent

description: Windows-only npm.cmd spawn with fixed args and no user input
fp_reason: Command is a hardcoded constant on win32 only; no untrusted input reaches the shell
rule_gap: shell:true should be downgraded when the command and args are constants

description: sudo appears only inside an echoed install hint
fp_reason: String literal in echo, never executed
rule_gap: sudo inside echo/quoted help text should not count as usage

description: prepare script initializes husky and swallows errors
fp_reason: Standard husky git-hook setup, no network or external code
rule_gap: husky prepare scripts are a benign lifecycle pattern

description: References /grilling and /domain-modeling skills not present in .claude/skills/
suggested_fix: Confirm these skills exist at user level or vendor them
